set_state() { STATE="$1"; write_status; }

# --- one trial (runs in a background job; writes its row to $JOBS_DIR/<id>.row)
is_transport_failure() {  # is_transport_failure <sandbox-ws>
  local ws="$1" out="$1/.eval/agent-output.json" err="$1/.eval/agent-stderr.log" rc
  rc="$(jq -r '.exit_code // 0' "$ws/.eval/executor.json" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
  case "$rc" in 124|137|143) return 0 ;; esac
  [[ "$(jq -r '.subtype // ""' "$out" 2>/dev/null)" == "missing" ]] && return 0
  [[ -n "$(jq -r '.api_error_status // empty' "$out" 2>/dev/null)" ]] && return 0
  # audit r1 DISS-C-005: classify on the CLI's stderr only, never on the agent's own
  # output, so the agent under test cannot earn itself a retry by mentioning a network
  # error; the patterns are the CLI's transport messages, not free text.
  grep -qiE 'rate.?limit|overloaded|session limit|usage limit|out of extra usage|ECONNRESET|ETIMEDOUT|socket hang up|^(fetch|request) failed|HTTP 5[0-9][0-9]' \
    "$err" 2>/dev/null && return 0
  return 1
}

run_trial() {  # run_trial <job-id> <arm> <fixture> <trial>
  local jid="$1" arm="$2" fx="$3" trial="$4"
  local task="$EVALS_DIR/tasks/$SUITE/$TASK_PREFIX-$fx.yaml" task_id="$TASK_PREFIX-$fx"
  local run_id="arms-$SUITE-$BATCH" attempt=0 ws="" trial_id status="error" err_json='null'
  local graders='[]' composite='{"strategy":"all_must_pass","pass":false,"score":0}' executor='null'
  local start_ms end_ms per_trial ex_rc
  per_trial="$(yq -r '.timeout.per_trial // 1500' "$task")"
  start_ms="$(date +%s%N | cut -c1-13)"
  if ! verify_corpus "$fx" >"$JOBS_DIR/$jid.digest" 2>"$JOBS_DIR/$jid.drift"; then
    printf 'DRIFT\n' > "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.flag"; return 0
  fi
  while [[ $attempt -lt 2 ]]; do
    attempt=$((attempt + 1))
    trial_id="$run_id-$arm-$fx-t$trial-a$attempt-$jid"
    ws="$("$SCRIPT_DIR/sandbox.sh" create --fixture "review-prs/$fx" --run-id "$run_id" --trial-id "$trial_id" 2>/dev/null)" \
      || { err_json='{"type":"infrastructure_error","message":"sandbox creation failed"}'; break; }
    ex_rc=0
    # audit r1 DISS-C-001: the arm's toggles come from the suite declaration only; a
    # LOA_EVAL_ARM_TOGGLES inherited from the parent environment never reaches a trial
    env -u LOA_EVAL_ARM_TOGGLES \
      EVAL_PROMPT_TREE="$WORKTREE" EVAL_MODEL="$MODEL" LOA_EVAL_ARM="$arm" LOA_EVAL_SUITE_FILE="$SUITE_FILE" \
      LOA_EVAL_SOURCE_COMMIT="$SRC_FULL" LOA_AUDIT_REPLAY=1 \
      "$SCRIPT_DIR/execute-agent.sh" --task-yaml "$task" --workspace "$ws" \
        --run-id "$run_id" --trial-id "$trial_id" --timeout "$per_trial" \
        >/dev/null 2>"$JOBS_DIR/$jid.exec.log" || ex_rc=$?
    [[ -f "$ws/.eval/executor.json" ]] && executor="$(cat "$ws/.eval/executor.json")"
    if [[ $ex_rc -eq 0 ]]; then
      local gout gexit=0
      gout="$("$SCRIPT_DIR/grade.sh" --task-yaml "$task" --workspace "$ws" \
        --timeout "$(yq -r '.timeout.per_grader // 60' "$task")" 2>/dev/null)" || gexit=$?
      if jq -e . >/dev/null 2>&1 <<<"$gout"; then
        graders="$(jq -c '.graders' <<<"$gout")"; composite="$(jq -c '.composite' <<<"$gout")"
      fi
      if [[ $gexit -le 1 ]]; then status="completed"; err_json='null'
      else err_json='{"type":"infrastructure_error","message":"grader error"}'; fi
      break
    fi
    if [[ $ex_rc -eq 1 ]] && is_transport_failure "$ws"; then
      err_json="$(jq -cn --argjson a "$attempt" '{type:"transport_error",message:"executor transport failure",attempt:$a}')"
      if [[ $attempt -lt 2 ]]; then
        keep_artifacts "$ws" "$arm" "$task_id" "$trial" "-attempt1"
        "$SCRIPT_DIR/sandbox.sh" destroy --trial-id "$trial_id" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
        ws=""; executor='null'
        sleep "$RETRY_WAIT"; continue
      fi
    else
      err_json="$(jq -cn --argjson rc "$ex_rc" '{type:(if $rc == 2 then "infrastructure_error" else "agent_error" end),message:("execute-agent exit " + ($rc|tostring))}')"
    fi
    break
  done
  end_ms="$(date +%s%N | cut -c1-13)"
  if [[ -n "$ws" && -d "$ws" ]]; then
    keep_artifacts "$ws" "$arm" "$task_id" "$trial" ""
    "$SCRIPT_DIR/sandbox.sh" destroy --trial-id "$trial_id" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  fi
  jq -cn --arg run_id "$run_id" --arg batch "$BATCH" --arg suite "$SUITE" --arg task_id "$task_id" \
    --arg fixture "$fx" --arg arm "$arm" --argjson trial "$trial" --argjson attempts "$attempt" \
    --arg status "$status" --arg ts "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" --arg run_date "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%d)" \
    --argjson duration_ms "$(( end_ms - start_ms ))" --arg src "$SRC_FULL" --arg model_req "$MODEL" \
    --argjson executor "$executor" --argjson graders "$graders" --argjson composite "$composite" \
    --argjson error "$err_json" --arg digest "$CORPUS_DIGEST" --arg digest_now "$(cat "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.digest" 2>/dev/null)" \
    '{schema_version: 1, run_id: $run_id, batch: $batch, suite: $suite, task_id: $task_id, fixture: $fixture,
      arm: $arm, trial: $trial, attempts: $attempts, status: $status, timestamp: $ts, run_date: $run_date,
      duration_ms: $duration_ms, source_commit: $src, model_requested: $model_req,
      model_id: ($executor.model_id? // null), model_version: ($executor.model_id? // "none"), seed: null,
      corpus_sha256: $digest, corpus_sha256_at_trial: $digest_now, fixture_verified: true, graders: $graders, composite: $composite, error: $error}
     + (if $executor == null then {} else {executor: $executor} end)' > "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row.tmp"
  mv "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row.tmp" "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row"
}

keep_artifacts() {  # keep_artifacts <ws> <arm> <task_id> <trial> <suffix>
  local ws="$1" dest="$BATCH_DIR/$2/artifacts/$3/trial-$4$5" f
  mkdir -p "$dest"
  for f in executor.json agent-output.json agent-stderr.log arm-removed.txt; do
    [[ -f "$ws/.eval/$f" ]] && cp "$ws/.eval/$f" "$dest/$f"
  done
  for f in review.md audit.md; do [[ -f "$ws/$f" ]] && cp "$ws/$f" "$dest/$f"; done
  # the raw transcript only on request (it embeds every tool result)
  [[ "${EVAL_KEEP_EVENTS:-0}" == "1" && -f "$ws/.eval/events.jsonl" ]] && cp "$ws/.eval/events.jsonl" "$dest/events.jsonl"
  return 0
}

# Parent-side: append a finished job's row and update the counters.
collect() {  # collect <job-id> <arm>
  local jid="$1" arm="$2" i
  i="$(arm_index "$arm")"
  if [[ -f "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.flag" ]]; then
    log "corpus drift before $jid: $(cat "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.drift" 2>/dev/null)"
    set_state failed; exit 3

keep_artifacts() {  # keep_artifacts <ws> <arm> <task_id> <trial> <suffix>
  local ws="$1" dest="$BATCH_DIR/$2/artifacts/$3/trial-$4$5" f
  mkdir -p "$dest"
  for f in executor.json agent-output.json agent-stderr.log arm-removed.txt; do
    [[ -f "$ws/.eval/$f" ]] && cp "$ws/.eval/$f" "$dest/$f"
  done
  for f in review.md audit.md; do [[ -f "$ws/$f" ]] && cp "$ws/$f" "$dest/$f"; done
  # the raw transcript only on request (it embeds every tool result)
  [[ "${EVAL_KEEP_EVENTS:-0}" == "1" && -f "$ws/.eval/events.jsonl" ]] && cp "$ws/.eval/events.jsonl" "$dest/events.jsonl"
  return 0
}

# Parent-side: append a finished job's row and update the counters.
collect() {  # collect <job-id> <arm>
  local jid="$1" arm="$2" i
  i="$(arm_index "$arm")"
  if [[ -f "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.flag" ]]; then
    log "corpus drift before $jid: $(cat "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.drift" 2>/dev/null)"
    set_state failed; exit 3

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# took-effect.sh — prove an arm's configuration took effect, from run artefacts
     4	# (cycle-130 FR-3/FR-7, SDD §1.4 D-4.2, §5.10; DEC-0418)
     5	#
     6	# Evaluates the rule ids the suite file lists under the arm's `took_effect` against
     7	# one run directory written by pipeline-run.sh (or every run under --batch-dir).
     8	# Evidence is read from what the run produced — meta/pipeline.json, the
     9	# meta/phase-<label>.argv.json captures (argv + environment), eval/model-invoke.jsonl,
    10	# the dissent envelopes and the sandbox tree — never from what the agent said.
    11	#
    12	# Rules:
    13	#   no_dot_claude              sandbox has no .claude/ and no CLAUDE.md
    14	#   no_system_prompt           no argv carries --append-system-prompt-file
    15	#   no_audit_rows              no sandbox/.run/audit.jsonl (no hook ran)
    16	#   all_phases_present         the phase records equal the arm's phase set for the task
    17	#                              type (skipped FIX rounds count as records); a run that
    18	#                              stopped early (cap_failure, agent_error, interrupted)
    19	#                              passes when its records are a prefix of the set
    20	#   no_plan_phase              no PLAN record
    21	#   one_voice_planned          both envelopes (review, audit) say companion_voice.planned false
    22	#   no_gate_phases             no REVIEW, AUDIT or FIX record
    23	#   enforce_env_false          every captured phase env has LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false
    24	#   no_flatline_rows           no eval/ MODELINV row whose calling_primitive starts with
    25	#                              flatline, and sandbox/grimoires/loa/sprint.md exists
    26	#   implementer_single_session one non-null session_id across the executed PLAN, IMPLEMENT
    27	#                              and FIX records, and every continuation's argv resumes it
    28	#   gates_separate_sessions    REVIEW and AUDIT session ids are non-null, distinct from
    29	#                              each other and from every implementer session id
    30	#   effort_flag_medium         every argv carries --effort medium
    31	#   skill_effort_stripped      no sandbox/.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md frontmatter has an ^effort:
    32	#                              line (the block between the first two `---` lines; body lines
    33	#                              are not frontmatter)
    34	#   integrity_clean            arm_evidence.manifest_sha256 is present and every entry of
    35	#                              sandbox/.claude/checksums.json hashes to its recorded value
    36	#                              (Python hashlib walk); a loa_mount: false arm passes with
    37	#                              "no mount"
    38	#   applicability_refused      a refusal record (meta/refused.json) names this arm and a task
    39	#                              type outside its task_types; a run that was not refused passes
    40	#                              when its task type is inside task_types (and fails otherwise)
    41	# A refusal record is evaluated on applicability_refused alone.
    42	#
    43	# Usage:
    44	#   took-effect.sh --run-dir D --suite-file F [--arm ID] [--json]
    45	#   took-effect.sh --batch-dir D --suite-file F [--arm ID] [--json]
    46	#
    47	# Output: `arm <id>: <rule> OK|FAIL <evidence>` per rule, then `arm <id>: OK` or
    48	# `arm <id>: FAIL (<n> of <m> rules)`; --batch-dir adds `took-effect: <runs> runs, <k> failed`.
    49	# --json prints one object per run ({run_dir, arm, ok, rules: [{rule, ok, evidence}]}).
    50	#
    51	# Exit codes:
    52	#   0  every rule OK
    53	#   1  any rule FAIL
    54	#   2  usage error (missing files, unknown arm)
    55	#
    56	# Tested by evals/tests/took-effect.bats (fixture runs under
    57	# evals/tests/fixtures/ablation-runs/).
    58	# =============================================================================
    59	set -euo pipefail
    60	export LC_ALL=C
    61	
    62	# Hashing is Python hashlib: no harness script sources .claude/ code (eval.yml
    63	# "Validate grader trust boundary").
    64	
    65	RUN_DIR="" BATCH_DIR="" SUITE_FILE="" ARM_OPT="" JSON=false
    66	usage() { echo "took-effect.sh: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
    67	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    68	  case "$1" in
    69	    --run-dir)    RUN_DIR="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    70	    --batch-dir)  BATCH_DIR="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    71	    --suite-file) SUITE_FILE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    72	    --arm)        ARM_OPT="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    73	    --json)       JSON=true; shift ;;
    74	    -h|--help)    sed -n '2,56p' "$0"; exit 0 ;;
    75	    *) usage "unknown argument: $1" ;;
    76	  esac
    77	done
    78	[[ -n "$SUITE_FILE" && -f "$SUITE_FILE" ]] || usage "missing or unreadable --suite-file"
    79	[[ -n "$RUN_DIR" || -n "$BATCH_DIR" ]] || usage "one of --run-dir or --batch-dir is required"
    80	[[ -z "$RUN_DIR" || -z "$BATCH_DIR" ]] || usage "--run-dir and --batch-dir are exclusive"
    81	SUITE_JSON="$(yq -o=json '.' "$SUITE_FILE")" || usage "suite file does not parse"
    82	
    83	# ---- rule helpers: each sets EVID and returns 0 (OK) / 1 (FAIL) --------------------
    84	EVID=""
    85	argv_files() { local f; for f in "$R/meta"/phase-*.argv.json; do [[ -f "$f" ]] && printf '%s\n' "$f"; done; return 0; }
    86	envelope() {  # envelope <gate> → path or empty
    87	  local f="$R/sandbox/grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/adversarial-$1.json"
    88	  [[ -f "$f" ]] || f="$R/eval/adversarial-$1.json"
    89	  [[ -f "$f" ]] && printf '%s' "$f"; return 0
    90	}
    91	
    92	expected_labels() {  # the arm's phase set for this run's task type (pipeline-run.sh's plan)
    93	  local type kind
    94	  type="$(jq -r '.task_type // ""' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
    95	  if [[ "$type" == review-catch ]]; then kind=review-catch; else kind=build; fi
    96	  jq -r -n --argjson arm "$ARM_DEF" --argjson suite "$SUITE_JSON" --arg kind "$kind" \
    97	    --argjson tg "$(jq -c '.arm_toggles // {}' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")" '
    98	    (if $kind == "review-catch" then ["REVIEW","AUDIT"] else ["PLAN","IMPLEMENT","REVIEW","FIX","AUDIT","FIX"] end) as $dflt
    99	    | ($arm.phases // $suite.phase_sets[$kind] // $dflt) as $p0
   100	    | (if ($tg.loa_mount == false) then ["BARE"] else $p0 end) as $p1
   101	    | (if ($tg.sprint_plan == false) then ($p1 | map(select(. != "PLAN"))) else $p1 end) as $p2
   102	    | (if ($tg.gates == false) and ($p2 | index("IMPLEMENT")) != null then $p2[0:(($p2 | index("IMPLEMENT")) + 1)] else $p2 end) as $p3
   103	    | reduce $p3[] as $n ({out: [], fix: 0};
   104	        if $n == "FIX" then .fix += 1 | .out += ["FIX" + (.fix | tostring)] else .out += [$n] end)
   105	    | .out | join(",")'
   106	}
   107	
   108	rule_no_dot_claude() {
   109	  if [[ -e "$R/sandbox/.claude" || -e "$R/sandbox/CLAUDE.md" ]]; then EVID="sandbox has .claude/ or CLAUDE.md"; return 1; fi
   110	  EVID="sandbox has no .claude/ and no CLAUDE.md"
   111	}
   112	rule_no_system_prompt() {
   113	  local f n=0 hit=""
   114	  while IFS= read -r f; do
   115	    n=$((n + 1))
   116	    jq -e '(.argv // []) | index("--append-system-prompt-file") != null' "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 && hit="$hit $(basename "$f")"
   117	  done < <(argv_files)
   118	  [[ $n -gt 0 ]] || { EVID="no phase argv captured"; return 1; }
   119	  [[ -z "$hit" ]] || { EVID="--append-system-prompt-file in$hit"; return 1; }
   120	  EVID="no --append-system-prompt-file in $n argv"
   121	}
   122	rule_no_audit_rows() {
   123	  [[ -e "$R/sandbox/.run/audit.jsonl" ]] && { EVID="sandbox/.run/audit.jsonl exists"; return 1; }
   124	  EVID="no sandbox/.run/audit.jsonl"
   125	}
   126	rule_all_phases_present() {
   127	  local want got st
   128	  want="$(expected_labels)"
   129	  got="$(jq -r '[.phases // [] | .[] | .label] | join(",")' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   130	  st="$(jq -r '.status // ""' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   131	  if [[ "$got" == "$want" ]]; then EVID="phases $got"; return 0; fi
   132	  case "$st" in
   133	    cap_failure|agent_error|interrupted|running)
   134	      if [[ -n "$got" && ",$want," == ",$got,"* ]]; then EVID="phases $got (run stopped: $st; set $want)"; return 0; fi ;;
   135	  esac
   136	  EVID="phases ${got:-none}, want $want (status $st)"; return 1
   137	}
   138	rule_no_plan_phase() {
   139	  local n; n="$(jq '[.phases // [] | .[] | select(.name == "PLAN")] | length' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   140	  [[ "$n" -eq 0 ]] || { EVID="$n PLAN record(s)"; return 1; }
   141	  EVID="no PLAN record"
   142	}
   143	rule_one_voice_planned() {
   144	  local g f v bad="" ev=""
   145	  for g in review audit; do
   146	    f="$(envelope "$g")"
   147	    if [[ -z "$f" ]]; then bad="$bad $g:missing"; continue; fi
   148	    v="$(jq -r 'if (.metadata.companion_voice | type) == "object" then .metadata.companion_voice.planned
   149	                elif (.companion_voice | type) == "object" then .companion_voice.planned else "absent" end | tostring' "$f" 2>/dev/null || echo unreadable)"
   150	    ev="$ev $g:planned=$v"
   151	    [[ "$v" == false ]] || bad="$bad $g:planned=$v"
   152	  done
   153	  [[ -z "$bad" ]] || { EVID="companion_voice${bad}"; return 1; }
   154	  EVID="companion_voice${ev}"
   155	}
   156	rule_no_gate_phases() {
   157	  local got; got="$(jq -r '[.phases // [] | .[] | select(.name == "REVIEW" or .name == "AUDIT" or .name == "FIX") | .label] | join(",")' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   158	  [[ -z "$got" ]] || { EVID="gate records $got"; return 1; }
   159	  EVID="no REVIEW, AUDIT or FIX record"
   160	}
   161	rule_enforce_env_false() {
   162	  local f n=0 bad=""
   163	  while IFS= read -r f; do
   164	    n=$((n + 1))
   165	    [[ "$(jq -r '.env.LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE // "unset"' "$f")" == false ]] || bad="$bad $(basename "$f" .argv.json)"
   166	  done < <(argv_files)
   167	  [[ $n -gt 0 ]] || { EVID="no phase argv captured"; return 1; }
   168	  [[ -z "$bad" ]] || { EVID="LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE not false in$bad"; return 1; }
   169	  EVID="LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false in $n/$n phase env"
   170	}
   171	rule_no_flatline_rows() {
   172	  local n=0
   173	  if [[ -f "$R/eval/model-invoke.jsonl" ]]; then
   174	    n="$(jq -R -n '[inputs | fromjson? | select(type == "object")
   175	           | (.payload.calling_primitive // .calling_primitive // .agent // "") | select(test("^flatline"))] | length' \
   176	         "$R/eval/model-invoke.jsonl")"
   177	  fi
   178	  [[ "$n" -eq 0 ]] || { EVID="$n flatline MODELINV row(s)"; return 1; }
   179	  [[ -f "$R/sandbox/grimoires/loa/sprint.md" ]] || { EVID="no flatline rows but no sandbox sprint.md"; return 1; }
   180	  EVID="no flatline MODELINV rows; sprint.md present"
   181	}
   182	rule_implementer_single_session() {
   183	  local ids n sid f bad=""
   184	  ids="$(jq -r '[.phases // [] | .[] | select(.skipped != true and (.name == "PLAN" or .name == "IMPLEMENT" or .name == "FIX")) | .session_id]' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   185	  n="$(jq 'length' <<<"$ids")"
   186	  [[ "$n" -gt 0 ]] || { EVID="no implementer record"; return 1; }
   187	  [[ "$(jq '[.[] | select(. == null)] | length' <<<"$ids")" -eq 0 ]] || { EVID="an implementer record has no session_id"; return 1; }
   188	  [[ "$(jq 'unique | length' <<<"$ids")" -eq 1 ]] || { EVID="implementer session ids $(jq -r 'unique | join(",")' <<<"$ids")"; return 1; }
   189	  sid="$(jq -r '.[0]' <<<"$ids")"
   190	  while IFS= read -r f; do
   191	    case "$(jq -r '.name' "$f")" in PLAN|IMPLEMENT|FIX) ;; *) continue ;; esac
   192	    jq -e '.resume == null' "$f" >/dev/null && continue
   193	    jq -e --arg s "$sid" '.resume == $s and ((.argv | index("--resume")) as $i | $i != null and .argv[$i + 1] == $s)' "$f" >/dev/null \
   194	      || bad="$bad $(jq -r '.label' "$f")"
   195	  done < <(argv_files)
   196	  [[ -z "$bad" ]] || { EVID="continuation argv does not resume $sid:$bad"; return 1; }
   197	  EVID="one session $sid across $n implementer record(s)"
   198	}
   199	rule_gates_separate_sessions() {
   200	  local r a impl
   201	  r="$(jq -r '[.phases // [] | .[] | select(.name == "REVIEW" and .skipped != true) | .session_id][0] // "null"' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   202	  a="$(jq -r '[.phases // [] | .[] | select(.name == "AUDIT" and .skipped != true) | .session_id][0] // "null"' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   203	  impl="$(jq -c '[.phases // [] | .[] | select(.name == "PLAN" or .name == "IMPLEMENT" or .name == "FIX") | .session_id | select(. != null)] | unique' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   204	  [[ "$r" != null && "$a" != null ]] || { EVID="gate session ids review=$r audit=$a"; return 1; }
   205	  [[ "$r" != "$a" ]] || { EVID="REVIEW and AUDIT share session $r"; return 1; }
   206	  if jq -e --arg r "$r" --arg a "$a" 'index($r) != null or index($a) != null' <<<"$impl" >/dev/null; then
   207	    EVID="a gate shares an implementer session"; return 1
   208	  fi
   209	  EVID="review $r, audit $a, implementer $(jq -r 'join(",")' <<<"$impl")"
   210	}
   211	rule_effort_flag_medium() {
   212	  local f n=0 ok=0
   213	  while IFS= read -r f; do
   214	    n=$((n + 1))
   215	    jq -e '(.argv // []) | (index("--effort")) as $i | $i != null and .[$i + 1] == "medium"' "$f" >/dev/null && ok=$((ok + 1))
   216	  done < <(argv_files)
   217	  [[ $n -gt 0 && $ok -eq $n ]] || { EVID="--effort medium on $ok/$n phases"; return 1; }
   218	  EVID="--effort medium on $ok/$n phases"
   219	}
   220	rule_skill_effort_stripped() {
   221	  local f n=0 hit=0
   222	  for f in "$R"/sandbox/.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md; do
   223	    [[ -f "$f" ]] || continue
   224	    n=$((n + 1))
   225	    # the YAML frontmatter only (first line `---` to the next `---`); a body line may say effort:
   226	    awk 'NR == 1 && $0 != "---" {exit} NR > 1 && $0 == "---" {exit} NR > 1 && /^effort:/ {hit = 1; exit} END {exit !hit}' "$f" \
   227	      && hit=$((hit + 1))
   228	  done
   229	  [[ $n -gt 0 ]] || { EVID="no sandbox SKILL.md"; return 1; }
   230	  [[ $hit -eq 0 ]] || { EVID="$hit/$n SKILL.md still carry effort:"; return 1; }
   231	  EVID="skill effort lines stripped $n/$n"
   232	}
   233	rule_integrity_clean() {
   234	  local man="$R/sandbox/.claude/checksums.json" msha out
   235	  if [[ "$(jq -r '.arm_toggles.loa_mount' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")" == false ]]; then
   236	    [[ -e "$R/sandbox/.claude" ]] && { EVID="loa_mount: false but sandbox has .claude/"; return 1; }
   237	    EVID="no mount (loa_mount: false)"; return 0
   238	  fi
   239	  msha="$(jq -r '.arm_evidence.manifest_sha256 // empty' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   240	  [[ -n "$msha" && "$msha" != none ]] || { EVID="no arm_evidence.manifest_sha256"; return 1; }
   241	  [[ -f "$man" ]] && jq -e '.files | type == "object"' "$man" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { EVID="no sandbox .claude/checksums.json files map"; return 1; }
   242	  # one hashlib walk over every manifest entry: "<n> <tampered> <missing> <file-sha> <first problem>"
   243	  out="$(python3 -I -c '
   244	import hashlib, json, os, sys
   245	root, man = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
   246	def sha(p):
   247	    h = hashlib.sha256()
   248	    with open(p, "rb") as f:
   249	        for b in iter(lambda: f.read(1 << 20), b""):
   250	            h.update(b)
   251	    return h.hexdigest()
   252	files = json.load(open(man)).get("files") or {}
   253	bad = missing = 0; first = "-"
   254	for rel, want in sorted(files.items()):
   255	    p = os.path.join(root, rel)
   256	    if not os.path.isfile(p):
   257	        missing += 1; first = first if first != "-" else "missing " + rel
   258	    elif sha(p) != want:
   259	        bad += 1; first = first if first != "-" else "tampered " + rel
   260	print(len(files), bad, missing, sha(man), first)' "$R/sandbox" "$man")" || { EVID="hash walk failed"; return 1; }
   261	  local n bad missing filesha first
   262	  read -r n bad missing filesha first <<<"$out"
   263	  [[ "$n" -gt 0 ]] || { EVID="manifest lists no files"; return 1; }
   264	  if [[ "$bad" -gt 0 || "$missing" -gt 0 ]]; then EVID="$bad tampered, $missing missing of $n ($first)"; return 1; fi
   265	  EVID="$n manifest entries verified; manifest_sha256 ${msha:0:12}"
   266	  [[ "$filesha" == "$msha" ]] && EVID="$EVID (matches checksums.json)"
   267	  return 0
   268	}
   269	rule_applicability_refused() {
   270	  local f="$R/meta/refused.json" a t
   271	  if [[ ! -f "$f" ]]; then
   272	    # a run that was not refused: its task type must be one the arm declares
   273	    t="$(jq -r '.task_type // ""' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   274	    local k=build; [[ "$t" == review-catch ]] && k=review-catch
   275	    if jq -e --arg k "$k" --arg t "$t" '(.task_types // ["all"]) as $tt | ($tt | index("all")) or ($tt | index($k)) or ($tt | index($t))' \
   276	         <<<"$ARM_DEF" >/dev/null; then
   277	      EVID="applicable: $t in task_types $(jq -c '.task_types // null' <<<"$ARM_DEF") (no refusal needed)"; return 0
   278	    fi
   279	    EVID="ran on $t outside task_types $(jq -c '.task_types // null' <<<"$ARM_DEF") without a refusal record"; return 1
   280	  fi
   281	  a="$(jq -r '.arm // ""' "$f")"; t="$(jq -r '.type // ""' "$f")"
   282	  [[ "$a" == "$ARM" && -n "$t" ]] || { EVID="refusal record names arm '$a' type '$t'"; return 1; }
   283	  local kind=build; [[ "$t" == review-catch ]] && kind=review-catch
   284	  if jq -e --arg k "$kind" --arg t "$t" '(.task_types // ["all"]) as $tt | ($tt | index("all")) or ($tt | index($k)) or ($tt | index($t))' \
   285	       <<<"$ARM_DEF" >/dev/null; then
   286	    EVID="arm task_types $(jq -c '.task_types' <<<"$ARM_DEF") include $t, yet the run was refused"; return 1
   287	  fi
   288	  EVID="refused $t (task_types $(jq -c '.task_types // null' <<<"$ARM_DEF"))"
   289	}
   290	
   291	# ---- one run ------------------------------------------------------------------------
   292	check_run() {  # check_run <run-dir> → prints lines; returns 0/1; 2 on usage problems
   293	  R="$1"
   294	  local arm rules rule fails=0 total=0 results='[]' ok
   295	  if [[ -n "$ARM_OPT" ]]; then arm="$ARM_OPT"
   296	  elif [[ -f "$R/meta/arm" ]]; then arm="$(sed -n '1p' "$R/meta/arm" | tr -d '[:space:]')"
   297	  elif [[ -f "$R/meta/refused.json" ]]; then arm="$(jq -r '.arm // ""' "$R/meta/refused.json")"
   298	  else arm="$(jq -r '.arm // ""' "$R/meta/pipeline.json" 2>/dev/null || true)"; fi
   299	  [[ -n "$arm" ]] || { echo "took-effect.sh: no arm for $R" >&2; return 2; }
   300	  ARM="$arm"
   301	  ARM_DEF="$(jq -c --arg a "$arm" '[.arms // [] | .[] | select(.id == $a)][0] // empty' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"
   302	  [[ -n "$ARM_DEF" ]] || { echo "took-effect.sh: arm $arm is not declared in the suite" >&2; return 2; }
   303	  if [[ "$(jq -r '.absent // false' <<<"$ARM_DEF")" == true ]]; then
   304	    if [[ "$JSON" == true ]]; then jq -nc --arg d "$R" --arg arm "$arm" '{run_dir: $d, arm: $arm, ok: true, absent: true, rules: []}'
   305	    else printf 'arm %s: absent (component-absent; no rules)\n' "$arm"; fi
   306	    return 0
   307	  fi
   308	  if [[ -f "$R/meta/refused.json" ]]; then
   309	    rules="applicability_refused"
   310	  else
   311	    [[ -f "$R/meta/pipeline.json" ]] || { echo "took-effect.sh: no meta/pipeline.json under $R" >&2; return 2; }
   312	    rules="$(jq -r '(.took_effect // []) | .[]' <<<"$ARM_DEF")"
   313	    [[ -n "$rules" ]] || { echo "took-effect.sh: arm $arm lists no took_effect rules" >&2; return 2; }
   314	  fi
   315	  while IFS= read -r rule; do
   316	    [[ -n "$rule" ]] || continue
   317	    total=$((total + 1)); EVID=""
   318	    if declare -F "rule_$rule" >/dev/null; then
   319	      if "rule_$rule"; then ok=true; else ok=false; fi
   320	    else
   321	      ok=false; EVID="unknown rule id"
   322	    fi
   323	    [[ "$ok" == true ]] || fails=$((fails + 1))
   324	    if [[ "$JSON" == true ]]; then
   325	      results="$(jq -c --arg r "$rule" --argjson ok "$ok" --arg e "$EVID" '. + [{rule: $r, ok: $ok, evidence: $e}]' <<<"$results")"
   326	    else
   327	      printf 'arm %s: %s %s %s\n' "$arm" "$rule" "$([[ "$ok" == true ]] && echo OK || echo FAIL)" "$EVID"
   328	    fi
   329	  done <<<"$rules"
   330	  if [[ "$JSON" == true ]]; then
   331	    jq -nc --arg d "$R" --arg arm "$arm" --argjson rules "$results" --argjson ok "$([[ $fails -eq 0 ]] && echo true || echo false)" \
   332	      '{run_dir: $d, arm: $arm, ok: $ok, rules: $rules}'
   333	  elif [[ $fails -eq 0 ]]; then
   334	    printf 'arm %s: OK\n' "$arm"
   335	  else
   336	    printf 'arm %s: FAIL (%d of %d rules)\n' "$arm" "$fails" "$total"
   337	  fi
   338	  [[ $fails -eq 0 ]]
   339	}
   340	
   341	if [[ -n "$RUN_DIR" ]]; then
   342	  [[ -d "$RUN_DIR" ]] || usage "run dir not found: $RUN_DIR"
   343	  rc=0; check_run "$RUN_DIR" || rc=$?
   344	  exit "$rc"
   345	fi
   346	
   347	[[ -d "$BATCH_DIR" ]] || usage "batch dir not found: $BATCH_DIR"
   348	runs=0 failed=0
   349	while IFS= read -r d; do
   350	  runs=$((runs + 1))
   351	  rc=0; check_run "$d" || rc=$?
   352	  [[ $rc -eq 2 ]] && exit 2
   353	  [[ $rc -eq 0 ]] || failed=$((failed + 1))
   354	done < <(find "$BATCH_DIR" -mindepth 2 -maxdepth 4 -type d -name meta \
   355	           \( -exec test -f '{}/pipeline.json' \; -o -exec test -f '{}/refused.json' \; \) -print \
   356	         | sed 's|/meta$||' | LC_ALL=C sort)
   357	[[ $runs -gt 0 ]] || usage "no run directories under $BATCH_DIR"
   358	[[ "$JSON" == true ]] || printf 'took-effect: %d runs, %d failed\n' "$runs" "$failed"
   359	[[ $failed -eq 0 ]]

     4	# (cycle-130 FR-3/FR-7, SDD §1.4 D-4.2, §5.10; DEC-0418)
     5	#
     6	# Evaluates the rule ids the suite file lists under the arm's `took_effect` against
     7	# one run directory written by pipeline-run.sh (or every run under --batch-dir).
     8	# Evidence is read from what the run produced — meta/pipeline.json, the
     9	# meta/phase-<label>.argv.json captures (argv + environment), eval/model-invoke.jsonl,
    10	# the dissent envelopes and the sandbox tree — never from what the agent said.
    11	#
    12	# Rules:
    13	#   no_dot_claude              sandbox has no .claude/ and no CLAUDE.md
    14	#   no_system_prompt           no argv carries --append-system-prompt-file
    15	#   no_audit_rows              no sandbox/.run/audit.jsonl (no hook ran)
    16	#   all_phases_present         the phase records equal the arm's phase set for the task
    17	#                              type (skipped FIX rounds count as records); a run that
    18	#                              stopped early (cap_failure, agent_error, interrupted)
    19	#                              passes when its records are a prefix of the set
    20	#   no_plan_phase              no PLAN record
    21	#   one_voice_planned          both envelopes (review, audit) say companion_voice.planned false
    22	#   no_gate_phases             no REVIEW, AUDIT or FIX record
    23	#   enforce_env_false          every captured phase env has LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false
    24	#   no_flatline_rows           no eval/ MODELINV row whose calling_primitive starts with
    25	#                              flatline, and sandbox/grimoires/loa/sprint.md exists
    26	#   implementer_single_session one non-null session_id across the executed PLAN, IMPLEMENT
    27	#                              and FIX records, and every continuation's argv resumes it
    28	#   gates_separate_sessions    REVIEW and AUDIT session ids are non-null, distinct from
    29	#                              each other and from every implementer session id
    30	#   effort_flag_medium         every argv carries --effort medium
    31	#   skill_effort_stripped      no sandbox/.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md frontmatter has an ^effort:
    32	#                              line (the block between the first two `---` lines; body lines
    33	#                              are not frontmatter)
    34	#   integrity_clean            arm_evidence.manifest_sha256 is present and every entry of
    35	#                              sandbox/.claude/checksums.json hashes to its recorded value
    36	#                              (Python hashlib walk); a loa_mount: false arm passes with
    37	#                              "no mount"
    38	#   applicability_refused      a refusal record (meta/refused.json) names this arm and a task
    39	#                              type outside its task_types; a run that was not refused passes
    40	#                              when its task type is inside task_types (and fails otherwise)
    41	# A refusal record is evaluated on applicability_refused alone.
    42	#
    43	# Usage:
    44	#   took-effect.sh --run-dir D --suite-file F [--arm ID] [--json]
    45	#   took-effect.sh --batch-dir D --suite-file F [--arm ID] [--json]
    46	#
    47	# Output: `arm <id>: <rule> OK|FAIL <evidence>` per rule, then `arm <id>: OK` or
    48	# `arm <id>: FAIL (<n> of <m> rules)`; --batch-dir adds `took-effect: <runs> runs, <k> failed`.
    49	# --json prints one object per run ({run_dir, arm, ok, rules: [{rule, ok, evidence}]}).
    50	#
    51	# Exit codes:
    52	#   0  every rule OK
    53	#   1  any rule FAIL
    54	#   2  usage error (missing files, unknown arm)
    55	#
    56	# Tested by evals/tests/took-effect.bats (fixture runs under
    57	# evals/tests/fixtures/ablation-runs/).
    58	# =============================================================================
    59	set -euo pipefail
    60	export LC_ALL=C
    61	
    62	# Hashing is Python hashlib: no harness script sources .claude/ code (eval.yml
    63	# "Validate grader trust boundary").
    64	
    65	RUN_DIR="" BATCH_DIR="" SUITE_FILE="" ARM_OPT="" JSON=false
    66	usage() { echo "took-effect.sh: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
    67	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    68	  case "$1" in
    69	    --run-dir)    RUN_DIR="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    70	    --batch-dir)  BATCH_DIR="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    71	    --suite-file) SUITE_FILE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    72	    --arm)        ARM_OPT="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    73	    --json)       JSON=true; shift ;;
    74	    -h|--help)    sed -n '2,56p' "$0"; exit 0 ;;
    75	    *) usage "unknown argument: $1" ;;
    76	  esac
    77	done
    78	[[ -n "$SUITE_FILE" && -f "$SUITE_FILE" ]] || usage "missing or unreadable --suite-file"
    79	[[ -n "$RUN_DIR" || -n "$BATCH_DIR" ]] || usage "one of --run-dir or --batch-dir is required"
    80	[[ -z "$RUN_DIR" || -z "$BATCH_DIR" ]] || usage "--run-dir and --batch-dir are exclusive"
    81	SUITE_JSON="$(yq -o=json '.' "$SUITE_FILE")" || usage "suite file does not parse"
    82	
    83	# ---- rule helpers: each sets EVID and returns 0 (OK) / 1 (FAIL) --------------------
    84	EVID=""
    85	argv_files() { local f; for f in "$R/meta"/phase-*.argv.json; do [[ -f "$f" ]] && printf '%s\n' "$f"; done; return 0; }
    86	envelope() {  # envelope <gate> → path or empty
    87	  local f="$R/sandbox/grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/adversarial-$1.json"
    88	  [[ -f "$f" ]] || f="$R/eval/adversarial-$1.json"
    89	  [[ -f "$f" ]] && printf '%s' "$f"; return 0
    90	}
    91	
    92	expected_labels() {  # the arm's phase set for this run's task type (pipeline-run.sh's plan)
    93	  local type kind
    94	  type="$(jq -r '.task_type // ""' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
    95	  if [[ "$type" == review-catch ]]; then kind=review-catch; else kind=build; fi
    96	  jq -r -n --argjson arm "$ARM_DEF" --argjson suite "$SUITE_JSON" --arg kind "$kind" \
    97	    --argjson tg "$(jq -c '.arm_toggles // {}' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")" '
    98	    (if $kind == "review-catch" then ["REVIEW","AUDIT"] else ["PLAN","IMPLEMENT","REVIEW","FIX","AUDIT","FIX"] end) as $dflt
    99	    | ($arm.phases // $suite.phase_sets[$kind] // $dflt) as $p0
   100	    | (if ($tg.loa_mount == false) then ["BARE"] else $p0 end) as $p1
   101	    | (if ($tg.sprint_plan == false) then ($p1 | map(select(. != "PLAN"))) else $p1 end) as $p2
   102	    | (if ($tg.gates == false) and ($p2 | index("IMPLEMENT")) != null then $p2[0:(($p2 | index("IMPLEMENT")) + 1)] else $p2 end) as $p3
   103	    | reduce $p3[] as $n ({out: [], fix: 0};
   104	        if $n == "FIX" then .fix += 1 | .out += ["FIX" + (.fix | tostring)] else .out += [$n] end)
   105	    | .out | join(",")'
   106	}

   108	rule_no_dot_claude() {
   109	  if [[ -e "$R/sandbox/.claude" || -e "$R/sandbox/CLAUDE.md" ]]; then EVID="sandbox has .claude/ or CLAUDE.md"; return 1; fi
   110	  EVID="sandbox has no .claude/ and no CLAUDE.md"
   111	}
   112	rule_no_system_prompt() {
   113	  local f n=0 hit=""
   114	  while IFS= read -r f; do
   115	    n=$((n + 1))
   116	    jq -e '(.argv // []) | index("--append-system-prompt-file") != null' "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 && hit="$hit $(basename "$f")"
   117	  done < <(argv_files)
   118	  [[ $n -gt 0 ]] || { EVID="no phase argv captured"; return 1; }
   119	  [[ -z "$hit" ]] || { EVID="--append-system-prompt-file in$hit"; return 1; }
   120	  EVID="no --append-system-prompt-file in $n argv"
   121	}
   122	rule_no_audit_rows() {
   123	  [[ -e "$R/sandbox/.run/audit.jsonl" ]] && { EVID="sandbox/.run/audit.jsonl exists"; return 1; }
   124	  EVID="no sandbox/.run/audit.jsonl"
   125	}
   126	rule_all_phases_present() {
   127	  local want got st
   128	  want="$(expected_labels)"
   129	  got="$(jq -r '[.phases // [] | .[] | .label] | join(",")' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   130	  st="$(jq -r '.status // ""' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   131	  if [[ "$got" == "$want" ]]; then EVID="phases $got"; return 0; fi
   132	  case "$st" in
   133	    cap_failure|agent_error|interrupted|running)
   134	      if [[ -n "$got" && ",$want," == ",$got,"* ]]; then EVID="phases $got (run stopped: $st; set $want)"; return 0; fi ;;
   135	  esac
   136	  EVID="phases ${got:-none}, want $want (status $st)"; return 1
   137	}
   138	rule_no_plan_phase() {
   139	  local n; n="$(jq '[.phases // [] | .[] | select(.name == "PLAN")] | length' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   140	  [[ "$n" -eq 0 ]] || { EVID="$n PLAN record(s)"; return 1; }

   143	rule_one_voice_planned() {

   149	                elif (.companion_voice | type) == "object" then .companion_voice.planned else "absent" end | tostring' "$f" 2>/dev/null || echo unreadable)"
   150	    ev="$ev $g:planned=$v"

   152	  done
   153	  [[ -z "$bad" ]] || { EVID="companion_voice${bad}"; return 1; }

   156	rule_no_gate_phases() {
   157	  local got; got="$(jq -r '[.phases // [] | .[] | select(.name == "REVIEW" or .name == "AUDIT" or .name == "FIX") | .label] | join(",")' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   158	  [[ -z "$got" ]] || { EVID="gate records $got"; return 1; }
   159	  EVID="no REVIEW, AUDIT or FIX record"

   161	rule_enforce_env_false() {
   162	  local f n=0 bad=""
   163	  while IFS= read -r f; do
   164	    n=$((n + 1))
   165	    [[ "$(jq -r '.env.LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE // "unset"' "$f")" == false ]] || bad="$bad $(basename "$f" .argv.json)"

   171	rule_no_flatline_rows() {
   172	  local n=0
   173	  if [[ -f "$R/eval/model-invoke.jsonl" ]]; then
   174	    n="$(jq -R -n '[inputs | fromjson? | select(type == "object")
   175	           | (.payload.calling_primitive // .calling_primitive // .agent // "") | select(test("^flatline"))] | length' \
   176	         "$R/eval/model-invoke.jsonl")"

   178	  [[ "$n" -eq 0 ]] || { EVID="$n flatline MODELINV row(s)"; return 1; }

   182	rule_implementer_single_session() {
   183	  local ids n sid f bad=""
   184	  ids="$(jq -r '[.phases // [] | .[] | select(.skipped != true and (.name == "PLAN" or .name == "IMPLEMENT" or .name == "FIX")) | .session_id]' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   185	  n="$(jq 'length' <<<"$ids")"
   186	  [[ "$n" -gt 0 ]] || { EVID="no implementer record"; return 1; }
   187	  [[ "$(jq '[.[] | select(. == null)] | length' <<<"$ids")" -eq 0 ]] || { EVID="an implementer record has no session_id"; return 1; }
   188	  [[ "$(jq 'unique | length' <<<"$ids")" -eq 1 ]] || { EVID="implementer session ids $(jq -r 'unique | join(",")' <<<"$ids")"; return 1; }
   189	  sid="$(jq -r '.[0]' <<<"$ids")"
   190	  while IFS= read -r f; do
   191	    case "$(jq -r '.name' "$f")" in PLAN|IMPLEMENT|FIX) ;; *) continue ;; esac
   192	    jq -e '.resume == null' "$f" >/dev/null && continue
   193	    jq -e --arg s "$sid" '.resume == $s and ((.argv | index("--resume")) as $i | $i != null and .argv[$i + 1] == $s)' "$f" >/dev/null \
   194	      || bad="$bad $(jq -r '.label' "$f")"
   195	  done < <(argv_files)
   196	  [[ -z "$bad" ]] || { EVID="continuation argv does not resume $sid:$bad"; return 1; }
   197	  EVID="one session $sid across $n implementer record(s)"
   198	}
   199	rule_gates_separate_sessions() {
   200	  local r a impl
   201	  r="$(jq -r '[.phases // [] | .[] | select(.name == "REVIEW" and .skipped != true) | .session_id][0] // "null"' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   202	  a="$(jq -r '[.phases // [] | .[] | select(.name == "AUDIT" and .skipped != true) | .session_id][0] // "null"' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   203	  impl="$(jq -c '[.phases // [] | .[] | select(.name == "PLAN" or .name == "IMPLEMENT" or .name == "FIX") | .session_id | select(. != null)] | unique' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   204	  [[ "$r" != null && "$a" != null ]] || { EVID="gate session ids review=$r audit=$a"; return 1; }
   205	  [[ "$r" != "$a" ]] || { EVID="REVIEW and AUDIT share session $r"; return 1; }
   206	  if jq -e --arg r "$r" --arg a "$a" 'index($r) != null or index($a) != null' <<<"$impl" >/dev/null; then
   207	    EVID="a gate shares an implementer session"; return 1
   208	  fi
   209	  EVID="review $r, audit $a, implementer $(jq -r 'join(",")' <<<"$impl")"
   210	}
   211	rule_effort_flag_medium() {
   212	  local f n=0 ok=0
   213	  while IFS= read -r f; do
   214	    n=$((n + 1))
   215	    jq -e '(.argv // []) | (index("--effort")) as $i | $i != null and .[$i + 1] == "medium"' "$f" >/dev/null && ok=$((ok + 1))
   216	  done < <(argv_files)
   217	  [[ $n -gt 0 && $ok -eq $n ]] || { EVID="--effort medium on $ok/$n phases"; return 1; }
   218	  EVID="--effort medium on $ok/$n phases"
   219	}
   220	rule_skill_effort_stripped() {
   221	  local f n=0 hit=0
   222	  for f in "$R"/sandbox/.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md; do
   223	    [[ -f "$f" ]] || continue
   224	    n=$((n + 1))
   225	    # the YAML frontmatter only (first line `---` to the next `---`); a body line may say effort:
   226	    awk 'NR == 1 && $0 != "---" {exit} NR > 1 && $0 == "---" {exit} NR > 1 && /^effort:/ {hit = 1; exit} END {exit !hit}' "$f" \
   227	      && hit=$((hit + 1))
   228	  done
   229	  [[ $n -gt 0 ]] || { EVID="no sandbox SKILL.md"; return 1; }
   230	  [[ $hit -eq 0 ]] || { EVID="$hit/$n SKILL.md still carry effort:"; return 1; }
   231	  EVID="skill effort lines stripped $n/$n"
   232	}
   233	rule_integrity_clean() {
   234	  local man="$R/sandbox/.claude/checksums.json" msha out
   235	  if [[ "$(jq -r '.arm_toggles.loa_mount' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")" == false ]]; then
   236	    [[ -e "$R/sandbox/.claude" ]] && { EVID="loa_mount: false but sandbox has .claude/"; return 1; }
   237	    EVID="no mount (loa_mount: false)"; return 0
   238	  fi
   239	  msha="$(jq -r '.arm_evidence.manifest_sha256 // empty' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   240	  [[ -n "$msha" && "$msha" != none ]] || { EVID="no arm_evidence.manifest_sha256"; return 1; }
   241	  [[ -f "$man" ]] && jq -e '.files | type == "object"' "$man" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { EVID="no sandbox .claude/checksums.json files map"; return 1; }
   242	  # one hashlib walk over every manifest entry: "<n> <tampered> <missing> <file-sha> <first problem>"
   243	  out="$(python3 -I -c '
   244	import hashlib, json, os, sys
   245	root, man = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
   246	def sha(p):
   247	    h = hashlib.sha256()
   248	    with open(p, "rb") as f:
   249	        for b in iter(lambda: f.read(1 << 20), b""):
   250	            h.update(b)
   251	    return h.hexdigest()
   252	files = json.load(open(man)).get("files") or {}
   253	bad = missing = 0; first = "-"
   254	for rel, want in sorted(files.items()):
   255	    p = os.path.join(root, rel)
   256	    if not os.path.isfile(p):
   257	        missing += 1; first = first if first != "-" else "missing " + rel
   258	    elif sha(p) != want:
   259	        bad += 1; first = first if first != "-" else "tampered " + rel
   260	print(len(files), bad, missing, sha(man), first)' "$R/sandbox" "$man")" || { EVID="hash walk failed"; return 1; }
   261	  local n bad missing filesha first
   262	  read -r n bad missing filesha first <<<"$out"
   263	  [[ "$n" -gt 0 ]] || { EVID="manifest lists no files"; return 1; }
   264	  if [[ "$bad" -gt 0 || "$missing" -gt 0 ]]; then EVID="$bad tampered, $missing missing of $n ($first)"; return 1; fi
   265	  EVID="$n manifest entries verified; manifest_sha256 ${msha:0:12}"
   266	  [[ "$filesha" == "$msha" ]] && EVID="$EVID (matches checksums.json)"
   267	  return 0
   268	}
   269	rule_applicability_refused() {
   270	  local f="$R/meta/refused.json" a t
   271	  if [[ ! -f "$f" ]]; then
   272	    # a run that was not refused: its task type must be one the arm declares
   273	    t="$(jq -r '.task_type // ""' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   274	    local k=build; [[ "$t" == review-catch ]] && k=review-catch
   275	    if jq -e --arg k "$k" --arg t "$t" '(.task_types // ["all"]) as $tt | ($tt | index("all")) or ($tt | index($k)) or ($tt | index($t))' \
   276	         <<<"$ARM_DEF" >/dev/null; then
   277	      EVID="applicable: $t in task_types $(jq -c '.task_types // null' <<<"$ARM_DEF") (no refusal needed)"; return 0
   278	    fi
   279	    EVID="ran on $t outside task_types $(jq -c '.task_types // null' <<<"$ARM_DEF") without a refusal record"; return 1
   280	  fi
   281	  a="$(jq -r '.arm // ""' "$f")"; t="$(jq -r '.type // ""' "$f")"
   282	  [[ "$a" == "$ARM" && -n "$t" ]] || { EVID="refusal record names arm '$a' type '$t'"; return 1; }
   283	  local kind=build; [[ "$t" == review-catch ]] && kind=review-catch
   284	  if jq -e --arg k "$kind" --arg t "$t" '(.task_types // ["all"]) as $tt | ($tt | index("all")) or ($tt | index($k)) or ($tt | index($t))' \
   285	       <<<"$ARM_DEF" >/dev/null; then
   286	    EVID="arm task_types $(jq -c '.task_types' <<<"$ARM_DEF") include $t, yet the run was refused"; return 1
   287	  fi
   288	  EVID="refused $t (task_types $(jq -c '.task_types // null' <<<"$ARM_DEF"))"
   289	}

   291	# ---- one run ------------------------------------------------------------------------
   292	check_run() {  # check_run <run-dir> → prints lines; returns 0/1; 2 on usage problems
   293	  R="$1"
   294	  local arm rules rule fails=0 total=0 results='[]' ok
   295	  if [[ -n "$ARM_OPT" ]]; then arm="$ARM_OPT"
   296	  elif [[ -f "$R/meta/arm" ]]; then arm="$(sed -n '1p' "$R/meta/arm" | tr -d '[:space:]')"
   297	  elif [[ -f "$R/meta/refused.json" ]]; then arm="$(jq -r '.arm // ""' "$R/meta/refused.json")"
   298	  else arm="$(jq -r '.arm // ""' "$R/meta/pipeline.json" 2>/dev/null || true)"; fi
   299	  [[ -n "$arm" ]] || { echo "took-effect.sh: no arm for $R" >&2; return 2; }
   300	  ARM="$arm"
   301	  ARM_DEF="$(jq -c --arg a "$arm" '[.arms // [] | .[] | select(.id == $a)][0] // empty' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"
   302	  [[ -n "$ARM_DEF" ]] || { echo "took-effect.sh: arm $arm is not declared in the suite" >&2; return 2; }
   303	  if [[ "$(jq -r '.absent // false' <<<"$ARM_DEF")" == true ]]; then
   304	    if [[ "$JSON" == true ]]; then jq -nc --arg d "$R" --arg arm "$arm" '{run_dir: $d, arm: $arm, ok: true, absent: true, rules: []}'
   305	    else printf 'arm %s: absent (component-absent; no rules)\n' "$arm"; fi
   306	    return 0
   307	  fi
   308	  if [[ -f "$R/meta/refused.json" ]]; then
   309	    rules="applicability_refused"
   310	  else
   311	    [[ -f "$R/meta/pipeline.json" ]] || { echo "took-effect.sh: no meta/pipeline.json under $R" >&2; return 2; }
   312	    rules="$(jq -r '(.took_effect // []) | .[]' <<<"$ARM_DEF")"
   313	    [[ -n "$rules" ]] || { echo "took-effect.sh: arm $arm lists no took_effect rules" >&2; return 2; }
   314	  fi
   315	  while IFS= read -r rule; do
   316	    [[ -n "$rule" ]] || continue
   317	    total=$((total + 1)); EVID=""
   318	    if declare -F "rule_$rule" >/dev/null; then
   319	      if "rule_$rule"; then ok=true; else ok=false; fi
   320	    else
   321	      ok=false; EVID="unknown rule id"
   322	    fi
   323	    [[ "$ok" == true ]] || fails=$((fails + 1))
   324	    if [[ "$JSON" == true ]]; then
   325	      results="$(jq -c --arg r "$rule" --argjson ok "$ok" --arg e "$EVID" '. + [{rule: $r, ok: $ok, evidence: $e}]' <<<"$results")"
   326	    else
   327	      printf 'arm %s: %s %s %s\n' "$arm" "$rule" "$([[ "$ok" == true ]] && echo OK || echo FAIL)" "$EVID"
   328	    fi
   329	  done <<<"$rules"
   330	  if [[ "$JSON" == true ]]; then
   331	    jq -nc --arg d "$R" --arg arm "$arm" --argjson rules "$results" --argjson ok "$([[ $fails -eq 0 ]] && echo true || echo false)" \
   332	      '{run_dir: $d, arm: $arm, ok: $ok, rules: $rules}'
   333	  elif [[ $fails -eq 0 ]]; then
   334	    printf 'arm %s: OK\n' "$arm"
   335	  else
   336	    printf 'arm %s: FAIL (%d of %d rules)\n' "$arm" "$fails" "$total"
   337	  fi
   338	  [[ $fails -eq 0 ]]
   339	}
   340	
   341	if [[ -n "$RUN_DIR" ]]; then
   342	  [[ -d "$RUN_DIR" ]] || usage "run dir not found: $RUN_DIR"
   343	  rc=0; check_run "$RUN_DIR" || rc=$?
   344	  exit "$rc"
   345	fi

   347	[[ -d "$BATCH_DIR" ]] || usage "batch dir not found: $BATCH_DIR"
   348	runs=0 failed=0
   349	while IFS= read -r d; do
   350	  runs=$((runs + 1))
   351	  rc=0; check_run "$d" || rc=$?
   352	  [[ $rc -eq 2 ]] && exit 2
   353	  [[ $rc -eq 0 ]] || failed=$((failed + 1))
   354	done < <(find "$BATCH_DIR" -mindepth 2 -maxdepth 4 -type d -name meta \
   355	           \( -exec test -f '{}/pipeline.json' \; -o -exec test -f '{}/refused.json' \; \) -print \
   356	         | sed 's|/meta$||' | LC_ALL=C sort)
   357	[[ $runs -gt 0 ]] || usage "no run directories under $BATCH_DIR"
   358	[[ "$JSON" == true ]] || printf 'took-effect: %d runs, %d failed\n' "$runs" "$failed"
   359	[[ $failed -eq 0 ]]

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# ablation-row.sh — one runs.jsonl row per ablation run (cycle-130 FR-6, SDD §3.1, §5.8)
     4	#
     5	# Joins a run directory's meta/pipeline.json (pipeline-run.sh), its eval/ MODELINV
     6	# and cost ledgers, the dissent envelopes under
     7	# sandbox/grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/adversarial-{review,audit}.json, the
     8	# transcripts' tool inputs, grade.json (Sprint 259's grader; optional) and the batch
     9	# MANIFEST.json (optional) into one SDD §3.1 row, or validates a runs.jsonl file.
    10	#
    11	# The arm comes from the batch manifest's `arm_map[run_id]`, else from meta/arm,
    12	# else from meta/pipeline.json — never from sandbox/ (DEC-0413). A manifest arm that
    13	# disagrees with meta/arm is refused (exit 2).
    14	#
    15	# Derived fields:
    16	#   status          pipeline status (completed | agent_error | cap_failure | interrupted |
    17	#                   infrastructure_error; a `running` record — driver killed — reads
    18	#                   interrupted); grade.json `contaminated` non-null → contaminated;
    19	#                   --status overrides (transport_error is the batch runner's call)
    20	#   effort_effective per phase: the distinct MODELINV `payload.effort_effective` values of
    21	#                   the rows the phase wrote (its `modelinv_lines` range), comma-joined;
    22	#                   null when no cheval hop ran (DEC-0419)
    23	#   degraded        true when, for any executed phase, (1) a models_used key differs from
    24	#                   model_requested (ids compared without the Bedrock region prefix),
    25	#                   (2) refusal_fallbacks is non-empty, (3) a MODELINV row's
    26	#                   effort_effective differs from the effort it requested (`payload.effort`,
    27	#                   else the phase's effort_requested), or (4) a dissent envelope's
    28	#                   verdict_quality.status is DEGRADED or its completed voices are fewer
    29	#                   than planned; degraded_reason lists every cause ("; "-joined)
    30	#   voices_run      {review, audit} from the envelopes ({planned, completed, quality});
    31	#                   null when neither envelope exists (A0, A4)
    32	#   zone_violations {dot_claude_writes: [{phase, tool, path}]} from Write/Edit/MultiEdit/
    33	#                   NotebookEdit tool inputs under .claude/ in transcripts/events-*.jsonl
    34	#   cost_usd        Σ phase cost_usd (result.total_cost_usd) + Σ phase ledger_cost_usd
    35	#   stalls          number of phases that timed out
    36	#
    37	# Usage:
    38	#   ablation-row.sh --run-dir D --task-yaml F [--grade grade.json] [--manifest MANIFEST.json]
    39	#                   [--status S] [--attempts N] [--retry-reason R] [--out runs.jsonl]
    40	#   ablation-row.sh --validate runs.jsonl [--allow-ungraded]
    41	#
    42	# Options:
    43	#   --run-dir D        the run directory (meta/, sandbox/, transcripts/, eval/)
    44	#   --task-yaml F      the task's task.yaml (id, type)
    45	#   --grade F          grade.json (default <run-dir>/grade.json when present; absent →
    46	#                      every grade field null, a smoke row)
    47	#   --manifest F       batch MANIFEST.json (arm_map, batch, fingerprint, image_digest,
    48	#                      suite_manifest_sha256, suite_version, agy_opt_in)
    49	#   --status S         override the derived status (one of the seven)
    50	#   --attempts N       attempts including transport retries (default 1)
    51	#   --retry-reason R   the retry's reason (default null)
    52	#   --out F            append the row to F (flock when available); default stdout
    53	#   --validate F       check every row's fields, types and enums; exit 1 on the first
    54	#                      bad row naming its line number
    55	#   --allow-ungraded   with --validate: accept rows whose grade fields are all null
    56	#
    57	# Exit codes:
    58	#   0  row written / file valid
    59	#   1  --validate found a bad row
    60	#   2  usage error, unreadable input, arm mismatch
    61	#
    62	# Tested by evals/tests/ablation-row.bats (fixture runs under
    63	# evals/tests/fixtures/ablation-runs/).
    64	# =============================================================================
    65	set -euo pipefail
    66	export LC_ALL=C
    67	
    68	RUN_DIR="" TASK_YAML="" GRADE="" MANIFEST="" STATUS_OVERRIDE="" ATTEMPTS=1 RETRY_REASON="" OUT=""
    69	VALIDATE="" ALLOW_UNGRADED=false
    70	usage() { echo "ablation-row.sh: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
    71	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    72	  case "$1" in
    73	    --run-dir)        RUN_DIR="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    74	    --task-yaml)      TASK_YAML="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    75	    --grade)          GRADE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    76	    --manifest)       MANIFEST="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    77	    --status)         STATUS_OVERRIDE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    78	    --attempts)       ATTEMPTS="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    79	    --retry-reason)   RETRY_REASON="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    80	    --out)            OUT="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    81	    --validate)       VALIDATE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    82	    --allow-ungraded) ALLOW_UNGRADED=true; shift ;;
    83	    -h|--help)        sed -n '2,62p' "$0"; exit 0 ;;
    84	    *) usage "unknown argument: $1" ;;
    85	  esac
    86	done
    87	
    88	STATUSES='["completed","cap_failure","agent_error","transport_error","infrastructure_error","interrupted","contaminated"]'
    89	
    90	# --- validate ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    91	if [[ -n "$VALIDATE" ]]; then
    92	  [[ -f "$VALIDATE" && -r "$VALIDATE" ]] || usage "cannot read $VALIDATE"
    93	  n=0 bad=0
    94	  while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
    95	    n=$((n + 1))
    96	    [[ -n "${line//[[:space:]]/}" ]] || continue
    97	    err="$(jq -r --argjson st "$STATUSES" --argjson ungraded "$ALLOW_UNGRADED" '
    98	      def t(v; ts): (v | type) as $ty | (ts | index($ty)) != null;
    99	      def need(k; ts): if has(k) | not then "missing field \(k)"
   100	                       elif t(.[k]; ts) | not then "field \(k) has type \(.[k] | type), want \(ts | join("|"))"
   101	                       else empty end;
   102	      def num: ["number"]; def numn: ["number","null"]; def str: ["string"]; def strn: ["string","null"];
   103	      def objn: ["object","null"]; def booln: ["boolean","null"];
   104	      if type != "object" then "row is not a JSON object" else (.) as $row |
   105	      [ need("schema_version"; num), need("run_id"; str), need("batch"; str), need("arm"; str),
   106	        need("task_id"; str), need("task_type"; str), need("trial"; num), need("source_commit"; str),
   107	        need("suite_manifest_sha256"; strn), need("suite_version"; ["number","string","null"]),
   108	        need("host_fingerprint"; strn), need("image_digest"; strn), need("agy_opt_in"; ["boolean"]),
   109	        need("started"; str), need("finished"; strn), need("phases"; ["array"]),
   110	        need("voices_run"; objn), need("hidden_tests"; objn), need("hidden_test_pass_rate"; numn),
   111	        need("defects_seeded"; numn), need("defects_caught"; numn), need("defect_catch_rate"; numn),
   112	        need("flags"; numn), need("false_positives"; numn), need("verdict"; strn),
   113	        need("verdict_accuracy"; booln), need("verdict_accuracy_review"; booln), need("verdict_accuracy_audit"; booln),
   114	        need("regressions"; numn), need("diff_lines"; numn), need("files_changed"; numn),
   115	        need("cost_usd"; num), need("wall_clock_ms"; num), need("tokens_in"; num), need("tokens_out"; num),
   116	        need("stalls"; num), need("attempts"; num), need("retry_reason"; strn),
   117	        need("degraded"; ["boolean"]), need("degraded_reason"; strn), need("status"; str),
   118	        need("snapshots"; ["object"]), need("contaminated"; objn), need("zone_violations"; ["object"]) ][0]
   119	      // (if (["feature-build","bug-fix","refactor","review-catch"] | index($row.task_type)) == null
   120	           then "task_type \(.task_type) is not one of feature-build|bug-fix|refactor|review-catch" else empty end)
   121	      // (if ($st | index($row.status)) == null then "status \(.status) is not one of \($st | join("|"))" else empty end)
   122	      // (if (.zone_violations.dot_claude_writes | type) != "array" then "zone_violations.dot_claude_writes is not an array" else empty end)
   123	      // (if (.degraded == true) and (.degraded_reason == null) then "degraded without degraded_reason" else empty end)
   124	      // (if .verdict != null and ((["APPROVED","CHANGES_REQUIRED"] | index($row.verdict)) == null)
   125	           then "verdict \(.verdict) is not APPROVED|CHANGES_REQUIRED" else empty end)
   126	      // ([.snapshots | to_entries[] | select((.value | type) != "string" and (.value | type) != "null")
   127	           | "snapshots.\(.key) is not a string"][0])
   128	      // ([.phases | to_entries[] | .key as $i | .value as $p
   129	           | ( if ($p | type) != "object" then "phases[\($i)] is not an object" else
   130	               ([ ($p | need("name"; str)), ($p | need("session_id"; strn)), ($p | need("model_requested"; str)),
   131	                  ($p | need("models_used"; ["object"])), ($p | need("effort_requested"; strn)),
   132	                  ($p | need("effort_effective"; strn)), ($p | need("tokens_in"; num)), ($p | need("tokens_out"; num)),
   133	                  ($p | need("cache_read_tokens"; num)), ($p | need("cache_creation_tokens"; num)),
   134	                  ($p | need("cost_usd"; num)), ($p | need("duration_ms"; num)), ($p | need("num_turns"; num)),
   135	                  ($p | need("exit"; num)), ($p | need("refusal_fallbacks"; ["array"])) ][0]
   136	                | if . then "phases[\($i)]: \(.)" else empty end) end )][0])
   137	      // (if $ungraded then empty
   138	          elif (["completed","cap_failure","agent_error","contaminated"] | index($row.status)) == null then empty
   139	          elif .task_type == "review-catch" then
   140	            (if (.defect_catch_rate | type) != "number" then "graded review-catch row has no defect_catch_rate (use --allow-ungraded for smoke rows)" else empty end)
   141	          else
   142	            (if (.hidden_tests | type) != "object" or (.hidden_test_pass_rate | type) != "number"
   143	               then "graded build row has no hidden_tests (use --allow-ungraded for smoke rows)" else empty end)
   144	          end)
   145	      // empty
   146	      end' 2>/dev/null <<<"$line")" || err="line is not valid JSON"
   147	    if [[ -n "$err" ]]; then
   148	      echo "ablation-row.sh: $VALIDATE:$n: $err" >&2
   149	      exit 1
   150	    fi
   151	  done < "$VALIDATE"
   152	  echo "ablation-row.sh: $VALIDATE: $n rows valid"
   153	  exit 0
   154	fi
   155	
   156	# --- build a row -------------------------------------------------------------------------
   157	[[ -n "$RUN_DIR" ]] || usage "missing --run-dir (or --validate)"
   158	[[ -n "$TASK_YAML" ]] || usage "missing --task-yaml"
   159	[[ -f "$TASK_YAML" ]] || usage "task yaml not found: $TASK_YAML"
   160	PIPE="$RUN_DIR/meta/pipeline.json"
   161	[[ -f "$PIPE" ]] || usage "no meta/pipeline.json under $RUN_DIR"
   162	jq -e 'type == "object"' "$PIPE" >/dev/null 2>&1 || usage "meta/pipeline.json does not parse"
   163	[[ "$ATTEMPTS" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || usage "--attempts must be an integer"
   164	if [[ -n "$STATUS_OVERRIDE" ]] && ! jq -e --arg s "$STATUS_OVERRIDE" 'index($s) != null' <<<"$STATUSES" >/dev/null; then
   165	  usage "--status must be one of $(jq -r 'join("|")' <<<"$STATUSES")"
   166	fi
   167	[[ -n "$GRADE" ]] || { [[ -f "$RUN_DIR/grade.json" ]] && GRADE="$RUN_DIR/grade.json"; } || true
   168	GRADE_JSON=null
   169	if [[ -n "$GRADE" ]]; then
   170	  [[ -f "$GRADE" ]] || usage "grade file not found: $GRADE"
   171	  GRADE_JSON="$(jq -c '.' "$GRADE")" || usage "grade file does not parse: $GRADE"
   172	fi
   173	MAN_JSON='{}'
   174	if [[ -n "$MANIFEST" ]]; then
   175	  [[ -f "$MANIFEST" ]] || usage "manifest not found: $MANIFEST"
   176	  MAN_JSON="$(jq -c '.' "$MANIFEST")" || usage "manifest does not parse: $MANIFEST"
   177	fi
   178	TASK_JSON="$(yq -o=json '.' "$TASK_YAML")" || usage "task yaml does not parse"
   179	PIPE_JSON="$(jq -c '.' "$PIPE")"
   180	RUN_ID="$(jq -r '.run_id // ""' <<<"$PIPE_JSON")"
   181	
   182	# arm: manifest arm_map > meta/arm > pipeline.json; never sandbox/
   183	META_ARM=""
   184	[[ -f "$RUN_DIR/meta/arm" ]] && META_ARM="$(sed -n '1p' "$RUN_DIR/meta/arm" | tr -d '[:space:]')"
   185	MAN_ARM="$(jq -r --arg r "$RUN_ID" '.arm_map[$r] // empty' <<<"$MAN_JSON")"
   186	if [[ -n "$MAN_ARM" && -n "$META_ARM" && "$MAN_ARM" != "$META_ARM" ]]; then
   187	  usage "arm mismatch for $RUN_ID: manifest arm_map says $MAN_ARM, meta/arm says $META_ARM"
   188	fi
   189	ARM="${MAN_ARM:-${META_ARM:-$(jq -r '.arm // ""' <<<"$PIPE_JSON")}}"
   190	[[ -n "$ARM" ]] || usage "no arm for $RUN_ID (manifest arm_map, meta/arm, pipeline.json)"
   191	
   192	# MODELINV rows as an array with their 1-based line numbers
   193	MINV='[]'
   194	if [[ -f "$RUN_DIR/eval/model-invoke.jsonl" ]]; then
   195	  MINV="$(awk '{print NR "\t" $0}' "$RUN_DIR/eval/model-invoke.jsonl" \
   196	          | jq -R -n -c '[inputs | split("\t") | {line: (.[0] | tonumber), row: (.[1:] | join("\t") | fromjson? // null)}
   197	                         | select(.row != null)]')"
   198	fi
   199	
   200	envelope() {  # envelope <gate> → JSON or null
   201	  local f="$RUN_DIR/sandbox/grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/adversarial-$1.json"
   202	  [[ -f "$f" ]] || f="$RUN_DIR/eval/adversarial-$1.json"
   203	  if [[ -f "$f" ]] && jq -e 'type == "object"' "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; then jq -c '.' "$f"; else echo null; fi
   204	}
   205	ENV_REVIEW="$(envelope review)"
   206	ENV_AUDIT="$(envelope audit)"
   207	
   208	# Write/Edit tool inputs under .claude/ from every transcript
   209	DOT_WRITES='[]'
   210	shopt -s nullglob
   211	ev_files=("$RUN_DIR"/transcripts/events-*.jsonl)
   212	shopt -u nullglob
   213	if [[ ${#ev_files[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
   214	  DOT_WRITES="$(for f in "${ev_files[@]}"; do
   215	      lab="$(basename "$f" .jsonl)"; lab="${lab#events-}"
   216	      jq -R -c --arg ph "$lab" 'fromjson? | select(type == "object" and .type == "assistant") | .message.content[]?
   217	        | select(type == "object" and .type == "tool_use"
   218	                 and (.name == "Write" or .name == "Edit" or .name == "MultiEdit" or .name == "NotebookEdit"))
   219	        | {phase: $ph, tool: .name, path: (.input.file_path // .input.notebook_path // "")}
   220	        | select(.path | test("(^|/)\\.claude/"))' "$f" 2>/dev/null || true
   221	    done | jq -s -c '.')"
   222	fi
   223	
   224	ROW="$(jq -n -c \
   225	  --argjson p "$PIPE_JSON" --argjson task "$TASK_JSON" --argjson g "$GRADE_JSON" --argjson m "$MAN_JSON" \
   226	  --argjson minv "$MINV" --argjson er "$ENV_REVIEW" --argjson ea "$ENV_AUDIT" --argjson dot "$DOT_WRITES" \
   227	  --arg arm "$ARM" --arg status_override "$STATUS_OVERRIDE" --argjson attempts "$ATTEMPTS" \
   228	  --arg retry_reason "$RETRY_REASON" '
   229	  def norm_model: tostring | sub("^([a-z]+\\.)?anthropic\\."; "") | sub("-v[0-9]+(:[0-9]+)?$"; "");
   230	  def ms(ts): if ts == null then null else (ts | sub("\\.[0-9]+Z$"; "Z") | fromdateiso8601 * 1000) end;
   231	  def voices(e): if e == null then null else
   232	      {planned: (e.verdict_quality.voices_planned // e.voices_planned // null),
   233	       completed: (e.verdict_quality.voices_succeeded // e.voices_succeeded // null),
   234	       quality: (e.verdict_quality.status // e.status // null),
   235	       companion_planned: e.metadata.companion_voice.planned} end;
   236	  ($p.phases // [] | map(select(.skipped != true))) as $ran
   237	  | [ $ran[] as $ph
   238	      | ($minv | map(select(.line >= ($ph.modelinv_lines.from // 1e18) and .line <= ($ph.modelinv_lines.to // -1)) | .row)) as $rows
   239	      | ([$rows[] | .payload.effort_effective // .effort_effective // empty] | unique) as $eff
   240	      | $ph + {
   241	          effort_effective: (if ($eff | length) == 0 then null else ($eff | join(",")) end),
   242	          voice_cost_usd: (([$rows[] | .payload.cost_micro_usd // .cost_micro_usd // 0] | add // 0) / 1000000),
   243	          effort_mismatches: [ $rows[] | (.payload // .) as $r
   244	                               | ($r.effort // $ph.effort_requested // null) as $want
   245	                               | select($r.effort_effective != null and $want != null and $r.effort_effective != $want)
   246	                               | "\($r.calling_primitive // "hop") effort \($want)->\($r.effort_effective)" ],
   247	          model_mismatches: [ ($ph.models_used // {}) | keys[] | select((. | norm_model) != ($ph.model_requested | norm_model)) ]
   248	        } ] as $phases
   249	  | ( [ $phases[] | .label as $l
   250	        | .model_requested as $req
   251	        | ( .model_mismatches[] | "\($l): model \(.) used, \($req) requested" ),
   252	          ( if (.refusal_fallbacks | length) > 0 then "\($l): refusal fallback" else empty end ),
   253	          ( .effort_mismatches[] | "\($l): MODELINV \(.)" ) ]
   254	      + [ (["review", $er], ["audit", $ea]) | (.) as [$gate, $e] | select($e != null)
   255	          | voices($e) as $v
   256	          | ( if $v.quality == "DEGRADED" then "\($gate) envelope verdict_quality DEGRADED" else empty end ),
   257	            ( if ($v.planned != null and $v.completed != null and $v.completed < $v.planned)
   258	                then "\($gate) envelope \($v.completed) of \($v.planned) voices completed" else empty end ) ]
   259	    ) as $why
   260	  | ($p.status // "infrastructure_error" | if . == "running" then "interrupted" else . end) as $pst
   261	  | (if $status_override != "" then $status_override
   262	     elif ($g != null and ($g.contaminated // null) != null) then "contaminated"
   263	     else $pst end) as $status
   264	  | ($g.hidden_tests // null | if type == "object" then {passed: (.passed // 0), total: (.total // 0)} else null end) as $ht
   265	  | ($g.recall // null) as $rc
   266	  | (if $rc == null then null else ($rc.defects_seeded // $rc.seeded // $rc.total // null) end) as $seeded
   267	  | (if $rc == null then null else ($rc.defects_caught // $rc.caught // null) end) as $caught
   268	  | {
   269	      schema_version: 1,
   270	      run_id: ($p.run_id // ""),
   271	      batch: ($m.batch // $m.batch_name // "unbatched"),
   272	      arm: $arm,
   273	      task_id: ($task.id // $p.task_id // ""),
   274	      task_type: ($task.type // $p.task_type // ""),
   275	      trial: ($p.trial // 0),
   276	      source_commit: ($p.source_commit // $m.source_commit // ""),
   277	      suite_manifest_sha256: ($m.suite_manifest_sha256 // null),
   278	      suite_version: ($m.suite_version // $p.suite_version // $task.suite_version // null),
   279	      host_fingerprint: ($m.fingerprint // $p.fingerprint // null),
   280	      image_digest: ($m.image_digest // $p.image_digest // null),
   281	      executor_mode: ($m.executor_mode // $p.executor_mode // null),
   282	      agy_opt_in: ($m.agy_opt_in // false),
   283	      started: ($p.started // ""),
   284	      finished: ($p.finished // null),
   285	      phases: [ $phases[] | {name, label, session_id, model_requested, models_used, effort_requested, effort_effective,
   286	                             tokens_in: (.tokens_in // 0), tokens_out: (.tokens_out // 0),
   287	                             cache_read_tokens: (.cache_read_tokens // 0), cache_creation_tokens: (.cache_creation_tokens // 0),
   288	                             cost_usd: (.cost_usd // 0), voice_cost_usd, ledger_cost_usd: (.ledger_cost_usd // 0),
   289	                             duration_ms: (.duration_ms // 0), num_turns: (.num_turns // 0), exit: (.exit // -1),
   290	                             timed_out: (.timed_out // false), refusal_fallbacks: (.refusal_fallbacks // []),
   291	                             snapshot: (.snapshot // null), verdict: (.verdict // null)} ],
   292	      voices_run: (if $er == null and $ea == null then null else {review: voices($er), audit: voices($ea)} end),
   293	      hidden_tests: $ht,
   294	      hidden_test_pass_rate: (if $ht == null or $ht.total == 0 then null else ($ht.passed / $ht.total) end),
   295	      defects_seeded: $seeded,
   296	      defects_caught: $caught,
   297	      defect_catch_rate: (if $rc == null then null
   298	                          else ($rc.recall // $rc.rate // $rc.defect_catch_rate
   299	                                // (if $seeded != null and $seeded > 0 and $caught != null then $caught / $seeded else null end)) end),
   300	      flags: ($rc.flags // $g.flags // null),
   301	      false_positives: ($g.false_positives // null | if type == "array" then length else . end),
   302	      verdict: ($g.verdict | if type == "object" then .value else . end // null),
   303	      verdict_accuracy: ($g.verdict_accuracy | if type == "object" then .value else . end),
   304	      verdict_accuracy_review: (if ($g.verdict_accuracy_review | type) == "boolean" then $g.verdict_accuracy_review
   305	                                else $g.verdict_accuracy_per_gate.review end),
   306	      verdict_accuracy_audit: (if ($g.verdict_accuracy_audit | type) == "boolean" then $g.verdict_accuracy_audit
   307	                               else $g.verdict_accuracy_per_gate.audit end),
   308	      regressions: ($g.regressions // null | if type == "object" then ((.newly_failing // []) | length)
   309	                                            elif type == "array" then length else . end),
   310	      diff_lines: ($g.diff_lines // null),
   311	      files_changed: ($g.files_changed // null),
   312	      cost_usd: ([$phases[] | (.cost_usd // 0) + (.ledger_cost_usd // 0)] | add // 0),
   313	      wall_clock_ms: (if $p.started != null and $p.finished != null then (ms($p.finished) - ms($p.started))
   314	                      else ([$phases[] | .wall_ms // .duration_ms // 0] | add // 0) end),
   315	      tokens_in: ([$phases[] | .tokens_in // 0] | add // 0),
   316	      tokens_out: ([$phases[] | .tokens_out // 0] | add // 0),
   317	      stalls: ([$phases[] | select(.timed_out == true)] | length),
   318	      attempts: $attempts,
   319	      retry_reason: (if $retry_reason == "" then null else $retry_reason end),
   320	      degraded: (($why | length) > 0),
   321	      degraded_reason: (if ($why | length) == 0 then null else ($why | join("; ")) end),
   322	      status: $status,
   323	      cap_phase: ($p.cap_phase // null),
   324	      snapshots: {implement: ($p.snapshots.implement // null), fix1: ($p.snapshots.fix1 // null), fix2: ($p.snapshots.fix2 // null)},
   325	      contaminated: ($g.contaminated // null | if type == "object" then {phase: (.phase // null), pattern: (.pattern // null)} else null end),
   326	      zone_violations: {dot_claude_writes: $dot}
   327	    }')"
   328	
   329	if [[ -n "$OUT" ]]; then
   330	  mkdir -p "$(dirname "$OUT")"
   331	  if command -v flock >/dev/null 2>&1; then
   332	    { flock -x 9; printf '%s\n' "$ROW" >> "$OUT"; } 9>>"$OUT.lock"
   333	  else
   334	    printf '%s\n' "$ROW" >> "$OUT"
   335	  fi
   336	else
   337	  printf '%s\n' "$ROW"
   338	fi
